extraction.notes: Summer 2027 programs are still being developed; the named offerings remain explicitly labeled 2026 reference information. Tentative provider-wide 2027 weeks are June 13-18 and June 20-25, but no individual program has been assigned to them. Registration is expected mid-December 2026. The FAQ contains stale between-week dates (June 20 and June 22), inconsistent with the 2026 schedule; these were not used. Campus address is published, but the specific residence hall/check-in building is not identified. Individual pages retain full/waitlist notices, while the homepage says 2026 registration closed; availability uses the homepage closure.
